notes: DiscoFlate v3.84.1 — 🩹 The Competition and Bonus Round cards drew nothing. The views were built correctly and published correctly, then dropped on the way to the compositor: the virtual camera's state hand-picked which keys it forwarded and only ever named `poll`. All four card keys now come from one list, so the next card added can't repeat it. Also: rich output finally means something. It only ever reached the status/report blocks, so a config whose action rows are all plain message rows — which every shipped one is — produced a wall of bare text however rich you'd asked for. Event, milestone and minigame-result posts are now embed cards when it's on. And 🔇 Activation is currently off is one notice per person per buffer window instead of an answer to every single command.
